policy.selection: before model metrics; deterministic hash sampling and source balancing; no tuning from this evaluation
policy.general: completed standard-start rated Lichess arena human games; both online Elo 800..2200, no player title; >=16 plies; exact old UCI games excluded
policy.elite: Completed standard-start real broadcast tournament games, both PGN-reported Elo >=2600, >=16 plies; prior exact UCI excluded; cap1000/event, source balancing. GM/FIDE-ID tags are recorded when provided, not mandatory: older international PGN exports omit them; report coverage and do not claim every identity was independently verified.
policy.random: uniform random among all legal moves at every ply; standard start; deterministic independent seeds; stop at mate/stalemate/insufficient material/automatic75-move/fivefold repetition or 512 plies; keep truncation counts
policy.blocks: 20 blocks of 250 games per cohort, model reset per file; all groups same framing and reset policy
policy.uncertainty: resample entire blocks for intervals; describe source and player overlap limitations; sufficiently many games does not ensure representativeness
policy.native_speed: two native speed calls per 250-game block; each CLI times three encode/decode iterations after warmup
policy.phase_speed: separate same-core diagnostic binary; two repeated encode/decode iterations per block, transition clocks; report separately from unmodified native whole-file throughput
policy.confidence_intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 fixed-seed resamples of 20 entire blocks, conditional on sampled data, not independent-source/population intervals
policy.general_supplement: Initial arena candidates:4428, below target. Add up to150 rated games from 16 deterministic SHA-sorted eligible arena participants before any codec metrics; apply same ratings/titles/clock filters and global exact-game dedup. Source/player sampling limitations will be reported.
policy.elite_acquisition: Before any new-cohort codec measurements: discover six FIDE-profile pages each for Caruana and Carlsen; prioritize major large-event title categories then URL to reach sufficient unique input efficiently; cap1000/source, stop after6500 unique eligible candidates, hash/source-balanced5000 selected. Not a random population sample.
policy.header_coverage_correction: Made before any new-cohort codec metrics: 2022 World Blitz contains 185 both-2600 games but no FIDE-ID tags, so mandatory-ID parsing erroneously eliminated all of them. Eligibility follows the original rating/event definition; missing tag coverage is reported.
policy.elite_archive_supplement: Before any new-cohort codec metrics: real broadcast cached candidates supplemented by eight named world-leading player PGN archives from kinairi/chess-data, pinned Git commit and SHA256. Both PGN Elo >=2600, completed standard start >=16plies, no prior exact UCI, cap1000/archive/event, source-balanced5000. The mirror is a secondary public source; report its provenance and historical date range, not all-official-ID verification.

native_repetitions: two independent CLI calls per block; each CLI warms and times 3 repeats
schedule: phase calls interleave cohort by block; native round0 forward and round1 reverse block/cohort order
report: phase CDF costs and diagnostic phase wall time; untouched release native whole-file throughput; no model changes
intervals: 10000 fixed-seed percentile bootstrap resamples of 20 entire blocks; conditional on sampled data, not a population/source-independent CI
